text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is doing some mental
practice
right before her race...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So if someone gets in my way, I'll slam
on the
breaks and...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you scared me! I had no idea you
were
here! What's up?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess so. My heart just won't
stop
pounding.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But... you'll be the one in a whole other
world
soon, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You'll totally be entranced by my
running! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
